# Giglio

> Enterprise identity and authentication platform powered by FusionAuth for secure user management and single sign-on.

Giglio provides comprehensive authentication and identity management solutions for enterprise applications. The platform leverages FusionAuth technology to deliver secure, scalable SSO capabilities and user administration tools.

## Key Topics

- FusionAuth
- Authentication
- Single Sign-On (SSO)
- Identity Management
- User Management
- Login
- Admin Portal
- Enterprise Security
- Getting Started
- Documentation

## Authentication & SSO

- [FusionAuth](https://auth.giglio.com/): FusionAuth SSO solution for enterprise user management and authentication

## Getting Started

- [Documentation Links](https://giglio.com/docs): Quick access to platform documentation and resources
